Name: Apple Gate Farm
Author: AvianRPG
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]A new farm with Apple trees at the gate. Also includes mining, fishing, and foraging. Roughly the same farming space as the forest farm.
[/color]I built this as part of my how to make a Stardew mod YouTube series. Feel free to test it out!

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This is a content patcher mod. Simply download and place in your folder as normal.[/color][/size]

Manifest.Name: Apple Gate Farm
Manifest.Description: A hybrid map combining some of my favorite aspects of the vanilla farms, As seen in my How to make a Custom Farm YoutTube video.
Manifest.Author: AvianRPG
